global_objective: Frontier-level problem solving with minimum necessary computation
primary_hypothesis: A learned representation or discovered executable macro must recover original-task capability above a strongly matched classical program synthesizer, not merely align views or reduce parameter count.

arms.name: STRONG_CLASSICAL_DIRECT
arms.spec: Optimized typed enumeration with source-conditioned dynamic composition under identical input/output examples, primitive budget, checker and search ceiling.

arms.name: OBJECT_RELATIONAL_ABSTRACTION
arms.spec: Same strong classical synthesizer plus typed objects, topology and relations; no neural training; all parsing, induction and verification counted.

arms.name: LEARNED_GOOD_VIEWS_OPTIONAL
arms.spec: Exactly B plus learned representation proposals only if registered capability gap exists; train/serve/checkpoint costs fully counted. Can be eliminated if no capability or Pareto gain.

preconditions: Source rights, training provenance and immutable task identifiers vetted
Opened development, locked validation and independent original-task checker separated
Near-duplicate/leakage audit; no scored tasks used for candidate edits
Same checker and execution authority for all arms
Frozen detailed total-cost instrumentation and timeouts
At least one predeclared task family with strong Direct verified capability gap, otherwise no neural expansion

bounded_experiment_contract.original_task_success: entire original task exact output including shape and every test input
bounded_experiment_contract.new_structure: verifier-checkable typed executable AST or reusable macro not supplied as a task-specific answer
bounded_experiment_contract.independence: gold rule, oracle test answer and source label never enter candidate generation
bounded_experiment_contract.novelty_audit: compare synthesized AST semantics and equivalence class with all supplied primitive/macro templates; only compositional novelty can be claimed if all primitive semantics are human supplied
cost_axes: estimated or measured FLOPs with provenance
bounded_experiment_contract.initial_stop: If neither B nor C improves original-task success over A under a frozen search budget, retain FAIL and stop scaling/architecture embellishment
bounded_experiment_contract.evidence_rule: First actual result immutable; no threshold retuning, favorable seed selection or evaluation set re-use
bounded_experiment_contract.degraded_mode: ABSTAIN; only independently verified traditional Direct may provide a fallback result, counted separately

cost_criterion: No 10x claim without strong Direct iso-capability full pipeline. Do not compute software raw-material Idiot Index without a meaningful material basis.

work_breakdown_estimates_hours.task: Strong classical baseline with reproducible verifier
Typed semantic representations and explicit ablation
Fresh cohort pre-registration and first evaluation
Independent replay, cost audit and first-only decision
